sources_note: S-level: Roblox official APIs (games/groups/thumbnails/experience-guidelines) and the studio website cinnamon.co.uk; A-level: Roblox DevForum posts by Cinnamon Go! group members whose role was checked via the groups API. Community wikis and code sites were NOT used for any field below; details only they report are listed in unverified_fields. Roblox experiences have no version number, so game_version is null — use 'accessed' and the Roblox 'updated' timestamp (2026-09-19T00:32:58Z at fetch time).

blockspin-game.summary_en: Open-world action game on Roblox, published by the Cinnamon Go! group (owned and managed by Cinnamon Software) and set in a Florida county.
blockspin-game.role_en: Publisher: Cinnamon Go! (Roblox group) · Studio: Cinnamon Software
blockspin-game.platforms_en: Roblox; a developer's Sept 2025 forum post reports PlayStation crashes and no increase on Xbox; mobile not confirmed
unverified_fields: platforms_en: mobile support (Roblox playable-devices data needs a signed-in request)

code-w7c28d.summary_en: The only code printed in the official BlockSpin game description.

death-drop.summary_en: Official warning in the game description.
death-drop.outcome_en: You drop everything in your inventory
death-drop.usage_en: Place items into the safe in your house to keep them secure
unverified_fields: whether carried cash counts as inventory
whether other players can pick up dropped items

ban-appeal-game.summary_en: Separate Roblox experience published by the Cinnamon Go! group for players banned from BlockSpin.
unverified_fields: whether it covers every type of BlockSpin ban

quick-11.summary_en: Convenience store shown in official BlockSpin promotional art.
unverified_fields: usage_en: Shelf Stocker job (community sources only: blockspintools.com, blockspinvalues.com)

fishing.summary_en: Activity shown in an official BlockSpin promotional thumbnail captioned "Fishing"; an official event listing is titled "NEW JOB - FISHING!".

_page_slug_note: page_slug points at content/blockspin/en/<slug>.md; jobs and map-locations are draft, so their entities render nowhere until those pages publish.
